name: TerraPower
description: Bellevue, Washington company founded by Bill Gates in 2008; its Natrium sodium-cooled fast reactor with molten-salt storage (345 MWe boosting to 500 MW) is under construction in Wyoming under the US Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program with GE Vernova Hitachi.
